name: Doki Doki Daigaku
source: When a computer glitch mysteriously ruins your perfect GPA, you're forced to attend summer school at an all-girls university to maintain your scholarship. The change of scenery isn't so bad—until your former high school rival takes roll. With your vacation ruined, can you drag the struggling members of WISH back into the spotlight, or is this the end of your dreams?
translation: 当电脑故障神秘地破坏了你完美的GPA时，你被迫去一所女子大学参加暑期学校，以维持你的奖学金。环境的变化并没有那么糟糕——直到你以前的高中对手上场。你的假期被毁了，你能否将苦苦挣扎的WISH成员重新拉回聚光灯下，或者这就是你梦想的终结吗？
